text: 11月3日，一张标注发布机构为野村、声称将中际旭创A股目标价下调至330元的研报截图正在投资社群快速流转。在光模块板块情绪本就敏感的当下，这条消息迅速扩散，搅动个股盘面。 野村相关人士回复表示，“事宜不属实。”也就是说，野村从未发布过这份下调目标价的研报，相关流传内容属于不实信息。无论署名分析师、发布文号、盈利测算口径，均找不到对应的正式研报记录，不存在下调目标价至330元这一动作。（界面）
text_en: On November 3, a screenshot of a research report attributed to Nomura and claiming to cut the A-share target price of Zhongji Innolight to 330 yuan circulated rapidly in investor communities. With sentiment in the optical module sector already sensitive, the news spread quickly and roiled the stock's trading. A Nomura representative responded that 'the matter is untrue.' In other words, Nomura never published this target-price cut report, and the circulating content is false information. No corresponding formal research report record can be found, whether by named analyst, publication number or profit estimate basis, and no action to cut the target price to 330 yuan exists. (Jiemian)
